title: Open-Source Library for DeFi Smart Contracts in Aiken

ms.promise:
・Description: Initiate the project by establishing foundational structures and engaging with the Cardano community for input and collaboration.
・Activities: Engagement with the Cardano DeFi community to get feedback, gather requirements, and promote participation.
ms.criteria:
1) Collecting community feedback via Google Form about what kind of Defi contracts are most desired to make the library as useful as possible for the DeFI projects:
・At least 6 types of contract desired by the community. 
・At least 1 more team will contribute to the development.

2) As part of the requirements, we will create the templates that can be used for a standardised development of the contracts and usage in the library.
ms.report:
Here is the document with the POA, including all relevant links to Google Forms, Github and other documents:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xNq3jymLZaATMJIadrc8Ixy-muyNILGB_9IB020R_FU/edit?usp=sharing

ms.promise:
General information:
・In the 1st milestone, community feedback will be gathered and used to determine the DeFI smart contracts (at least 6) that we will develop for this library in Aiken.
・In each milestones 2, 3 and 4, 1/3 of the contracts will be developed.

Activities for milestone 2:
First set (1/3) of DeFi smart contracts included:
・Write the contracts in Aiken.
・Create blueprint for Tx builder. 
・Conduct testing.
・Write documentation for easy use for developers.
ms.criteria:
・Successful implementation of each contract.
・Contracts pass testing and validation.
・Documentation for each contract is created and accessible.
ms.report:
For Milestone 2 we have finished the first two smart contracts (incl. off-chain code) as defined in Milestone 1:
・Collateral management logic
・Issuance & redemption logic (aka lending pool management)

Below you will find the POA:
・Onchain-Code (incl. Aiken Workspace and Validators):
・https://github.com/TrustLevel/defi-library-onchain
・Offchain-Code (to demonstrate the smart contracts):
・https://github.com/TrustLevel/defi-library-offchain
・Video to demonstrate the successful testing & validation of the smart contracts
・https://www.loom.com/share/486476bf042044228c4f2bc9e6ed61e5?sid=499286ad-7cd1-4a46-87ec-6502e5f2119d
・Guide to validate example transactions:
・https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LHfntMahMkTQSiDWL9s7RhweHyoUj0uL_3AD5r2LO98/edit?usp=sharing

Note to MR comment:
Please note that the launch of the library on Mesh is not planned until the last milestone. We are designing the library so that most contracts have links to each other. See M2, for example, where collateral and issuance/redemption logic can be used together. We will do the same with M3, where Liquidation and Oracle integration can be linked to the contracts from M2, and so on. An immediate launch would mean a lot of duplicate work until we get to the final version. For this reason, we have planned to use the Github documentation as POA for M2-M4 first and only the entire launch in M5.
